BAPHON connects pediatric hematology/oncology nurses across Northern California through education, networking, and advocacy for our patients and families.

Join BAPHON Upcoming Events

Who We Are

BAPHON is the Bay Area local chapter of APHON (Association of Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Nurses), a national professional organization dedicated to optimal nursing care for children and adolescents with cancer and their families.

We plan educational events and an annual symposium, as well as networking opportunities for our chapter members and other interested nurses throughout Northern California.

Call for Posters

BAPHON 11th Annual Symposium — Our First Two-Day Conference!

Reflect, Recharge, & Reignite · April 30 – May 1, 2027 · Flamingo Resort & Spa, Santa Rosa, CA

This is BAPHON's inaugural poster session! We invite members and non-members to submit abstracts on original research, quality improvement projects, or practice/education initiatives relevant to pediatric hematology/oncology and BMT nursing — an excellent opportunity to share your work, projects, and innovations with colleagues.

📅 Abstracts accepted: September 1 – December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM PT

Following the abstract review, selected authors will be notified and given a timeline and guidance for developing and submitting their finalized poster ahead of the April 2027 conference.

Learning Gaps / Suggested Poster Topics

See the full breakdown of subtopics in the Call for Abstracts (PDF).

Oncology
Cellular Therapies
Supportive Care/Symptom Management
Adolescent/Young Adult (AYA)
Chemotherapy/Biotherapy
Hematology
Management/Administration
Advanced Practice
Psychosocial
General Clinical Practice
Nursing Practice
Nurse Education and Professional Development

Poster Requirements

Poster abstracts must reflect completed projects. Abstracts for in-progress projects, or that don't meet requirements below, will be administratively rejected. Not sure if your project is ready? Complete the Abstract Readiness Self-Assessment (PDF) first.

  • Title — 20 words or fewer. Not all lowercase or all uppercase.
  • Abstract — 300 words or fewer, written as a narrative (no bullet points), with no references. Please indicate whether your submission is research, quality improvement, or practice/education based, and address the following:
    • Basis of inquiry — the problem, existing knowledge, and rationale for your approach
    • Purpose/objectives — your research question, project aim, or evaluation objective
    • Methods — design, sample/setting, measures, and analytic or evaluation strategy
    • Findings/outcomes — results and their implications for pediatric hematology/oncology nursing
    • Conference learning gaps — which learning gap(s) above your presentation addresses
    • Learning outcome — what learners will be able to do as a result of your presentation (e.g., recall/classify/solve/demonstrate)
  • Presenting author — name, credentials, and affiliation for all authors.

Accepted posters will be displayed at the symposium and presenters are expected to attend and be available during the poster session for discussion. Final poster specifications (size and format) will be shared with accepted presenters ahead of the conference.

Day 2 (6 CEs) · 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

📝 Registration Opening Soon Hotel Room Block

About the Conference

BAPHON’s inaugural two-day conference is coming in 2027!

We are thrilled to bring you “Reflect, Recharge, Reignite: Hematology Oncology Nursing at the Flamingo!” — two days packed with learning, connection, inspiration, and plenty of opportunities to recharge with fellow pediatric hematology/oncology nurses.

We’ve assembled an exciting lineup of expert speakers and timely topics designed to educate, inspire, and reignite your passion for what we do.

And because you asked, we listened! Following popular demand from our 2026 Symposium attendees, we’re excited to welcome back Pam Simon, PNP and Dr. Josh Fronk for another engaging AYA Survivorship Panel featuring fresh perspectives and meaningful conversation.

We can’t wait to Reflect, Recharge, and Reignite with all of you at the Flamingo! 🦩✨

Membership

Why Join BAPHON?

  • Connect with a local community of pediatric hematology/oncology nurses who understand your work.
  • Take part in educational events and an annual symposium to stay current in the field.
  • Build relationships with Bay Area colleagues who share your commitment to improving care for children with cancer.
  • Strengthen your professional network through a chapter that combines learning, collaboration, and support.

Supporters & Exhibitors

BAPHON depends on and is grateful for the organizations that help make our educational events outstanding. By supporting BAPHON, your organization demonstrates its commitment to pediatric hematology/oncology nursing education across Northern California. Your support helps us host CE dinners, symposiums, and provide educational opportunities to our chapter members.

Questions? Contact our Sponsor Liaison: sponsors@baphon.org
